title: Unlocalized increasing-wedge Koszul boundary evaluation
statement: For a commutative ring A, a finite sequence f, its extended negative Koszul tail I at exponent e+1 [def-sc-koszul-open-system], a complex F of module sheaves, and a degree n Hom cochain z [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex], let B_J be the transported increasing wedge for each nonempty subset. If card(J)>1, evaluation of d_I followed by the component of z on B_J equals minus the sum over j in J of (-1)^position*f(j)^(e+1) times the evaluation on B_(J.erase j), transported in the coefficient degree by principalCech_erase_degree [def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total]. Position is the number of elements of J smaller than j. This statement has no localization, denominator, Hom-differential sign or totalization sign.

source.place: Stacks Project Tag 08D0, first differential calculation, and Tag 08D1, Hom complex degree conventions; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D0 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D1.

proof.text: Apply the proved ExteriorAlgebra.boundary_wedge in Sheaf.RingTheory.KoszulGeneratorChainMap. For an increasing enumeration of a finite subset, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique identifies its composition with Fin.succAbove with the increasing enumeration of the erased subset. Identify the subset of smaller elements with the image of Finset.Iio of the position and count it. Reindex the contraction sum by Finset.orderIsoOfFin, evaluate linearCombination on each standard basis vector, and remove the extra even sign exponent. These steps are proved by the private helpers ordered_erase, ordered_position, and boundary_sorted.

Write card(J)=k+2. Reindex the given basis identities using equality elimination, then use HomologicalComplex.extend_d_eq and ChainComplex.of_d to transport the negative tail boundary to minus koszulBoundary at k+1. Apply boundary_sorted and linearity of extendXIso.inv and z.v to distribute the negative, finite sum, and scalar coefficients. Every erased subset has cardinality k+1 and hence is nonempty. Reindex its given basis identity at k and use equality elimination in the private evaluate_extend_transport helper with principalCech_erase_degree to obtain exactly the displayed coefficient eqToHom.

theorem koszulCechBoundary_evaluation (e : ℕ)
    (B : ∀ J : {J : Finset (Fin r) // J.Nonempty},
      ((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat).X
        (1 - (J.val.card : ℤ)))
    (hB : ∀ J, B J =
      ((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat
        (show ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat.f (J.val.card - 1) =
          1 - (J.val.card : ℤ) by
          simp only [ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat_f]
          have h : 0 < J.val.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr J.property
          omega)).inv
        (exteriorPower.ιMulti A (J.val.card - 1 + 1)
          (fun i ↦ Finsupp.single (J.val.orderEmbOfFin
            (show J.val.card = J.val.card - 1 + 1 by
              have h : 0 < J.val.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr J.property
              omega) i) (1 : A)))) (n : ℤ)
    (z : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain
      ((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
      (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F) n)
    (J : {J : Finset (Fin r) // J.Nonempty}) (hJ : 1 < J.val.card) :
    ((((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat).d
      (1 - (J.val.card : ℤ)) (2 - (J.val.card : ℤ)) ≫
      z.v (2 - (J.val.card : ℤ)) ((n + 1) + 1 - (J.val.card : ℤ)) (by ring)) (B J)) =
    -(∑ j : J.val, if h : (J.val.erase j.val).Nonempty then
      ((-1 : A) ^ ((J.val.filter (fun i ↦ i < j.val)).card) * f j.val ^ (e + 1)) •
        (affineOpenSections A ⊤).map
          (eqToHom (congrArg F.X
            (principalCech_erase_degree r J.val j.val j.property n)))
          ((z.v (1 - ((J.val.erase j.val).card : ℤ))
            (n + 1 - ((J.val.erase j.val).card : ℤ)) (by ring))
              (B ⟨J.val.erase j.val, h⟩))
      else 0)
